captions: Keep your participant list in Google Sheets, and Sert trust issues a verifiable certificate for every new row. Here is how to set it up in about ten minutes.
First, in Sert trust, open Manage, then A P I keys. Name the key Google Sheets, keep Read and Issue ticked, and select Create key.
Copy the key straight away. It is only shown once.
Now open your Google Sheet, and choose Extensions, then Apps Script.
Delete the starter code, paste the Sert trust script from our setup guide, and save.
Reload the sheet. A Sert trust menu appears. Choose Connect this tab.
The first time, Google asks for permission. If it says the app is unverified, choose Advanced, then go to the project, and allow. The script is your own private copy.
Choose Connect this tab again, paste your A P I key, and select Connect.
Pick the achievement this tab should issue, and save. The column headings are added for you.
Now add people, one per row, with a name and an email address.
Then choose Sert trust, Issue new rows now.
Each row gets a status, and a link to its certificate.
Every person receives their certificate by email,
with a page that anyone can use to check that it is genuine.
To issue without clicking, turn on automatic issuing. New rows are then issued every five minutes. The full guide is at sert trust dot app.
